candidates.tagline: New grass, new sprinklers — the World Cup pitch nailed 50% of that plan
candidates.story: During halftime of Norway vs Iraq at Gillette Stadium (June 16, 2026), a sprinkler erupted in Iraq's penalty box and flooded the pitch; ground crew rushed in with buckets while Norway's coach simultaneously complained the grass was 'tinder dry.'
candidates.why_funny: The irrigation system at a FIFA World Cup venue managed to both drown one end of the pitch and leave the other parched — at the same time.
candidates.alt: Ground crew workers with buckets and tools mopping water from the waterlogged Gillette Stadium pitch after a sprinkler flooded Iraq's penalty box during halftime of the Norway vs Iraq FIFA World Cup 2026 match

candidates.tagline: Lululemon's China anniversary: yoga, the Great Wall, and one very Japanese drum
candidates.story: Lululemon's 10th anniversary China event at the Great Wall used a Japanese taiko drum instead of a Chinese dagu drum — sparking 50 million Weibo views and a public apology on June 17, 2026.
candidates.why_funny: A global brand spent years in China without learning to distinguish a Japanese drum from a Chinese one — then put it front-and-centre at the Great Wall.
candidates.alt: Celebrity ambassador Zhu Yilong standing beside a large Japanese taiko drum on the Great Wall of China during Lululemon's 10th anniversary yoga event, the wrong instrument that sparked mass backlash
